None of the evidence passages contain financial data for the quarter ended October 25, 2026 (FY2027 Q3). The latest period covered in the evidence is July 26, 2026 (FY2027 Q2). 

Evidence E5 shows revenue data for Q1 FY2027 ($81,615 million for Apr 26, 2026 vs $44,062 million for Apr 27, 2025), demonstrating year-over-year growth in Q1, but this does not provide information about Q3 FY2027.

Since the evidence does not include any 10-Q or 10-K filing covering the quarter ended October 25, 2026, there is insufficient evidence to verify whether revenue increased year over year for that specific period.

output.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict, all three hypotheses were refuted:

H1 (Missing revenue data for Q3 FY2027): The counter-evidence confirms that the available filings only cover quarters ending April 26, 2026 (Q1 FY2027) and July 26, 2026 (Q2 FY2027). The numeric check also returned PERIOD_NOT_AVAILABLE for 2026-10-25, confirming no data exists for the quarter ended October 25, 2026.

H2 (Fiscal calendar confusion): Evidence E11 and E13 clearly identify July 26, 2026 as the "second quarter of fiscal year 2027," confirming that October 25, 2026 would indeed be Q3 FY2027 as originally assessed. There is no fiscal calendar confusion.

H3 (Missing 10-Q filing): The evidence shows only two 10-Q filings are available: one filed 2026-05-20 for Q1 FY2027 (ending April 26, 2026) and one filed 2026-08-26 for Q2 FY2027 (ending July 26, 2026). No 10-Q filing exists in the evidence for the quarter ending October 2026.

The claim requires revenue data for the quarter ended October 25, 2026 (Q3 FY2027), but the latest available filing only covers through July 26, 2026 (Q2 FY2027). The evidence cutoff date is 2026-10-15, which is before the quarter end date of October 25, 2026, making it impossible for a 10-Q covering that period to have been filed yet.

The verdict remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
output.change_reason: No change - all challenges were refuted and the initial verdict stands.
